rows.label: built Railjack and Reliquary Key
rows.alt: join a host for later Void Storms

conditions: Start from Cephalon Cy's inbox message or the Codex. The quest runs Arc Silver in Veil Proxima, Seven Sirens in Pluto Proxima, then Obol Crossing in Pluto Proxima.
bonuses: Extra main blueprints cost 50,000 Cephalon Simaris standing if the first is sold or subsumed.

conditions: The node must have an active Void Storm; running its ordinary Railjack mission gives no Sevagoth roll.
The blueprint roll is separate from relic rewards. Do not equip, refine or collect Reactant for a better Sevagoth chance.
Neptune's table is 9.52% rather than 10%, but its lower-level Nu-gua Mines laps are usually fastest. Pluto's Seven Sirens and Veil's Calabash are the other Exterminate options.
The roll is once at mission completion, with no pity system. Endless missions are not a shortcut.
bonuses: Veil is the better choice when you also want Corrupted Holokeys, Railjack Intrinsics, or Epitaph drops.
A built Railjack and capable crew can make an Exterminate lap roughly 5-6 minutes; weak ships can take twice that.

disclosures.title: treat this as a Railjack session
disclosures.body: All three parts are flat independent rolls with ugly variance and no token fallback. Run the shortest currently active eligible Exterminate, but set a second goal such as Holokeys or Intrinsics; farming only for one missing blueprint is the burnout trap. Average luck is about 10-15 storms, while long tails can be much worse.
